assert deadline_sequence('10;5,0,7')=='15,15,22'
assert deadline_sequence('0;0')=='0'

assert deadline_sequence('01;1') is None

import re
def deadline_sequence(s):
 p=s.split(';')
 if len(p)!=2 or not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*',p[0]) or not p[1]:return None
 n=int(p[0]);o=[]
 if n>10000000:return None
 for x in p[1].split(','):
  if not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*',x):return None
  n+=int(x)
  if n>10000000:return None
  o.append(str(n))
 return ','.join(o)
